description: This file defines the LeaveAllocateEmailProcessor class, responsible for processing leave allocation email notifications within the OrangeHRM system. It constructs email content by replacing placeholders with relevant leave and employee data, and determines the recipients based on roles. It leverages traits for services and includes methods for generating email content and recipient lists.

classes.name: LeaveAllocateEmailProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes leave allocation email notifications by generating dynamic email content and determining recipients based on roles within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Generates an array of placeholders with their corresponding values for email templates, based on leave allocation event data, including employee names, leave details, and comments.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Determines and returns a list of email recipients depending on the recipient role, such as subscriber, supervisor, or self.
